item.summary: Union Secretary, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Sudhansh Pant, today lauded Jammu and Kashmir’s extensive grassroots outreach under social welfare schemes and its coordinated, whole-of government approach to combating drug abuse, describing the UT’s efforts as a commendable model with potential for replication across the country.
item.title: Union Secretary MoSJ&E Shri Sudhansh Pant Lauds J&K’s Grassroots Welfare Outreach, Whole-Of-Government Approach Against Drug Abuse
